confidence_notes: I based the food and drink anchors on two web searches, one for exchange rates and one for Plovdiv prices. The price sources were crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregators (Numbeo, Expatistan, CityCost, Freenance, mylifeelsewhere), with dates between July and August 2026 where shown. Their figures were: draft beer about EUR 2.30 or 3.98 BGN, cappuccino about EUR 2.0-2.3, inexpensive meal about 12-15 BGN, and mid-range dinner for two about 78 BGN (about USD 47). I converted these to USD using estimates of about 1.96 BGN per EUR and about 1.16 USD per EUR. I did not look up the EUR/USD rate. The cocktail and wine prices are weaker: I did not find aggregated figures for them, so I estimated them from their usual price relationship to beer in Bulgaria. The accommodation figures are model estimates for July high season from general knowledge only. I did not search accommodation prices or check listings. The RBA rate of 0.6720 for 18 November 2026 came from a search summary that credits the RBA exchange-rates page, but I did not open the RBA page myself, so the rate should be checked there.
comparable_city_reasoning: Plovdiv is Bulgaria's second city and is about 24-32% cheaper than Sofia on cost-of-living indexes. I compared it with other mid-sized Balkan cities such as Veliko Tarnovo, Skopje and Niš, which have moderate tourism demand.
